name: AffordabilityAssessment
description: MCOB-compliant affordability assessment for a mortgage application. Created at DIP stage (soft check) and again at full application stage (binding assessment). Captures income, expenditure, stress test rate, and outcome. The full application stage assessment is authoritative for underwriting. Owned by SVC-002.

fields.name: gross_income
fields.validation_rule: Required. Positive decimal, GBP per annum. Declared at DIP; verified at full application.

fields.name: net_income
fields.validation_rule: Required. Positive decimal, GBP per annum. <= gross_income.

fields.name: committed_expenditure
fields.validation_rule: Required. Positive decimal or 0.00, GBP per month. Includes existing loans, credit cards, hire purchase, childcare.

fields.name: stress_test_rate
fields.validation_rule: Required. Annual percentage rate. Must be >= max(initial_rate + 3.0%, 7.0%) per MCOB 11.6.5. Immutable.

fields.name: monthly_payment_at_stress_rate
fields.validation_rule: Required. Computed monthly payment at stress_test_rate over full term. GBP.
